¿Y si mi suelo no está perfecto?: What if my floor is not perfect?
\nNo hace falta que lo esté. Necesitamos:
It does not need to be. We require industrial concrete in good condition, with no breaks or
spalling along the travel lane, with a local unevenness below about ±5 mm over 2 m
and expansion joints under 20 mm in width. We measure this during the technical visit and tell
you in numbers, not impressions. If there are stretches requiring localised adaptation,
they are identified and quoted before committing to anything.
¿Es más lento que un transbordador sobre: Is it slower than a rail-mounted transfer car?
\nEn velocidad punta, sí: 0,9 m/s frente:
At peak speed, yes: 0,9 m/s against the 1,5–2 m/s typical of a guided car. In effective
throughput the difference is much smaller, because cycle time is dominated by load
transfer, not travel. In the application study we simulate your actual cycle and give you the
transfers per hour you can expect. If the figure does not meet your need, we will tell you.
¿Qué pasa si se queda sin batería en mit: What happens if it runs out of battery in the middle of a shift?
\nNo debería ocurrir, porque la estrateg:
It should not happen, because the recommended strategy is opportunity charging: the platform
charges during every cycle pause and its level is permanently kept within a high band.
Even so, the system manages thresholds: on reaching the reserve level it completes the transfer in
progress and goes to charge, giving advance notice. It never stops with a load on board for lack
of energy.
¿Es seguro con personal y carretillas ci: Is it safe with personnel and forklifts moving through the area?
\nEs la situación para la que está diseñ:
This is the situation it is designed for. Safety laser scanners with fields adapted to
speed, a mechanical back-up bumper, monitored limited speed, audible
and visual signalling, and projection of the scanning zone onto the floor. Stopping distances
are verified with your actual load during the acceptance tests. The level of the measures is
adjusted to the actual traffic of your plant, which we assess during the visit.
Si falla, ¿se para mi línea?: If it fails, does my line stop?
\nUn fallo detiene el transbordo, no nec:
A fault stops the transfer, not necessarily the line. On critical installations a manual mode
with console is provided to evacuate the load on board, and the back-up procedure is defined
—usually a forklift— to maintain flow while the issue is resolved. In addition, the detailed
diagnostics drastically reduce the time to identify the fault, which is usually longer than
the repair time.
¿Puedo moverlo a otra zona dentro de dos: Can I move it to another area in two years' time?
\nSí, y es una de las razones principale:
Yes, and it is one of the main reasons for choosing this solution. Changing the run means editing
the map. Adding a destination means registering a station. Moving the equipment to another building requires
transport, remapping and adjustment of the new stations. None of this involves civil works.

file and EU declaration of conformity. You do not receive a set of components whose integration

¿Cuánto mantenimiento necesita?: How much maintenance does it need?
\nInspección periódica de bandas de roda:
Periodic inspection of tread bands, cleaning of navigation and safety optics,
annual verification of the safety functions and monitoring of battery condition. There is no
rail to clean or align, no brushes, no cable chain. The system itself warns of
the trends that anticipate intervention.
\nSe añade una segunda unidad al mismo p:
A second unit is added to the same aisle, with traffic management between the two. There is no need to
duplicate infrastructure because there is no infrastructure to duplicate. With the rail-based
solution, a second car usually means a second rail —and further civil works.
